title: 75% or 150%? The bulk Scotch fight that is testing the India-UK trade deal
short: 75% or 150%? The bulk Scotch fight testing the India-UK deal
dek: The India-UK trade pact halved the duty on Scotch in July. Now customs investigators say most of the Scotch India buys, the bulk kind used in Indian blends, doesn't qualify. Dozens of containers are stuck at ports.
card: About 80% of the Scotch India imports arrives in bulk. Customs wants 150% duty on it, not the 75% the trade deal promised.
hero_src: Data: Scotch Whisky Association, Reuters, DGCIS
